, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly pivoted to MAC/65 and Stephen D. Lawrow, conflating a different OSS cartridge-based system with the Atari Assembler Editor from Shepardson Microsystems—the company noted for authoring Atari BASIC. This contradicted earlier evidence identifying Kathleen O’Brien and would have led to the wrong answer.
